frames.prompt:
Edit IMAGE 1, the actual Russian NotebookLM page 1, into a native 1080x1920 vertical slide. IMAGE 1 is the sole content authority. IMAGE 2 is STYLE ONLY: warm ivory paper, dense fine engraved black lines, high-contrast Cyrillic serif typography, restrained red/blue decorative border. Absolutely do not copy its English title, three diamonds, arrows, explanatory text or semantic objects. Preserve the EXACT source Russian title "Три слоя исполнения ордеров" and subtitle "Механика биржевых заявок, алгоритмов и локальных условий". Do not translate, shorten, paraphrase, append any words, or add any label. Preserve the source's abstract horizontal stacked red upper / green lower order-book depth forms as an abstract chart texture with their same geometry and color relationship; they are NOT mountains, scenery, a skyline or people. Recompose these source forms below the title instead of inventing a new illustration. Keep every meaningful form inside the reserved content area. Remove only the tiny Gemini watermark during genuine restyling.
NATIVE PORTRAIT LAYOUT: This is a newly composed 9:16 frame, not a landscape image inside a portrait canvas. At final1080x1920, all critical text and source chart geometry must lie within x=140..790 and y=210..1390. A narrow tall engraved panel occupies the upper LEFT portion of the full paper canvas, with title at y=240..600, subtitle at y=650..870, original abstract red/green forms at y=930..1290. The border can occupy x=110..825,y=190..1420, but critical content never touches it. Keep the ENTIRE RIGHT x>=900 strip and ENTIRE BOTTOM y>=1500 area visually quiet ivory paper. Text must be large and fully readable, using line breaks as needed without changing any word. All title/subtitle and chart end well above y=1390. Do not fill the blank controls area with ornament, labels or a footer. No watermark, no extra content, no arrow, no three-layer stack or sample semantics.

exact_visible_text: Механика биржевых заявок, алгоритмов и локальных условий
